why: Defects in the pinned srsUE that this repository fixes locally until they are reported upstream. Patches are applied at build time into builds/srsran4g-zmq-local; the pinned tree src/srsRAN_4G and builds/srsran4g-zmq-release are never modified. The multi-UE and multi-gNB gates use the local build by default (OCUDU_NATIVE_SRSUE=stock opts out).

patches.why: Multi-UE RACH (SPARK_MILESTONES.md S16). proc_ra_nr hard-coded preamble 0, so UEs on one lock-step broker collided on the same PRACH occasion and preamble every time; ra_contention_resolution() completed RA for an RRC-started procedure even when the UE Contention Resolution Identity did not match; and demux passed Msg4's RRCSetup to RLC before the identity was checked. The loser adopted the winner's C-RNTI and failed NAS integrity. The patch picks a random contention-based preamble per attempt (SRSUE_PRACH_PREAMBLE_INDEX pins it), requires the identity to match for initial access and otherwise retries RA with backoff, and drops Msg4 SDUs that are not ours.

Single-cell scheduler benchmark, 4 UEs (2026-10-17 sessions g12, g15-g17). ra_response_reception() stopped the RAR timer before parsing the PDU: an RAR it could not unpack ('Error parsing RAR PDU, remaining bytes not sufficant') returned with no timer running, so the UE never transmitted another preamble; and an RAR without the UE's RAPID (its preamble missed when four UEs share one PRACH occasion) still started contention resolution. The patch completes RAR reception only on a matching RAPID (TS 38.321 5.1.4) and otherwise keeps monitoring the window, so rar_timeout_timer retransmits the preamble with power ramping. Applies after srsue-ra-contention.patch.

Extracts only the rx_sleep switch from the existing CMX integration patch. Default true preserves the pinned per-receive sleep; rx_sleep=false allows a broker that already paces IQ to own the clock, avoiding an additional full-block relative sleep in srsUE. No CMX PHY or TX changes are included.

NR LDPC decoding on aarch64 (ran_benchmark real time, 2026-10-24). srsRAN_4G has AVX2/AVX-512 LDPC decoders for x86 only; on aarch64 sch_nr falls back to the scalar C decoder (SRSRAN_LDPC_DECODER_C): 3.0 Mb/s coded on a Cortex-X925, 571 us per 8448-bit code block, 91% of the UE's PDSCH decode, 1.6-2.9 ms per 20 MHz slot, so every srsUE missed the 1 ms slot and the lock-step benchmark ran at 0.57x (4 UEs) / 0.40x (8 UEs). The patch adds a native NEON port of ldpc_dec_c_avx2long.c (ldpc_dec_c_neon.c: 16-byte sub-nodes, memcpy rotations, Q0.8 scaling; decoder type SRSRAN_LDPC_DECODER_C_NEON under HAVE_NEON), selects it by default on aarch64 in sch_nr.c (SRSRAN_LDPC_DECODER=c|simde|neon overrides), and adds ldpc_dec_neon_test (bit-exact against the reference for BG1/BG2, lifting sizes 2..384). Measured: 68 Mb/s coded on X925 (22x), 24 Mb/s on A725; live full-band decode p50 0.30 ms, 0.09 cores per UE. Also carries an optional SIMDe path (-DSRSRAN_LDPC_SIMDE=ON, off by default: compiles the AVX2 decoder through SIMDe, 10.5 Mb/s) that was the first fix and is kept for comparison.
patches.test: ldpc_dec_neon_test (lib/src/phy/fec/ldpc/test; run from the test directory that holds examplesBG1.dat/examplesBG2.dat)
